notes.gamepad: D-pad Right and Down move the same native selection as the arrow keys
notes.not checked: ButtonA, ButtonB and ButtonY: the input tools cannot send them; Return is the same native activation as A, and leaveActions is the function that B runs

checks.name: the g1 cell, Play and More are found
the g1 cell holds the selection
Return on the cell enters Play
ButtonB leaves the actions for the cell
the cell stays revealed after Back
the card reports it left the actions
ButtonY on More opens the card menu
the selection leaves the card for the menu
the card stays revealed while its menu is open
ButtonB returns the selection to More
the card stays revealed after the menu closes
